message:
An 8 MB upload is now accepted. The cause was `uploads.maxMb` in `config/default.json`, which was set to 5. I changed it to 10 to match `docs/product.md`. `npm test` passes (4 of 4).

The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is computed from the same setting (limit plus 1 MB), so it now allows up to 11 MB.
